dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament quarter-finals are approaching. Things are heating up! Audience members and competitors, please show us your excitement!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "To be honest, even though the competitions are exciting, the Fungi's abilities should really be applied in other areas as well. For example, they should be used to escort caravans or to guard the city."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If that happens, a lot of the pressure will be taken off the Corps of Thirty, and merchants wouldn't need to spend so much money on hiring bodyguards."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Goods might even become cheaper when the cost decreases! After all, I'm sure the merchants factor the cost of hiring bodyguards into the sale price of the goods. We, the customers, are the ones that pay for it."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "So I think it's safe to say that it could be very beneficial for us ordinary people if this event were to become even more popular!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I recommend banning the use of Stretchy Geo Fungi! The skills on that type of Fungus are way too strong!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Launching an entire team of Fungi in an instant is way too overpowered!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Haha, I can tell that you're an amateur from your comment! The strong abilities of Stretchy Geo Fungi come at a cost — the skill can't be used frequently in combat, and Stretchy Geo Fungi can easily be focused down!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If you use proper team composition, you'll be able to limit the Stretchy Geo Fungi's combat capabilities!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Kautilya, when are you gonna pay me back the money you owe me!?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Don't tell me you forgot about the 3,500 Mora you asked me for five years ago to pay for the medical supplies!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Don't you go ignoring a student who've run errands for you for years now that you're a big and successful researcher with a powerful sponsor!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Is this true? This is an accusation against someone important on the staff!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seems to be an official response to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Reminder from the Nilotpala Cup staff: This comment is not in violation and is within the parameters of the 'Friendly Comments' regulations. This comment will not be deleted."
